notes.title: Hero's Warband update
notes.content:
-Add new heroes!
-Elite and mythic for gunslingers
-mythic for druid and wraiths
and more
-Auto level feature will now learn skills and automatically allocate stat points randomly and will prioritize upgradable skills
-Balancing adjustments
-stat adjustments

notes.content:
